c74object.name: breakgen
c74object.digest: Generate tempo multipliers and breakpoint files for modmetro~
c74object.description:
Each bang advances an oscillator one step and outputs its value, shifted to center on 1.0, as a tempo multiplier. modmetro~ multiplies the length of each beat by one of these values: 1.0 leaves the beat unchanged, values above 1.0 lengthen it (slower) and values below 1.0 shorten it (faster).
The oscillator can be a sine, triangle, square, saw down or saw up wave, or a constant value, and its output can be randomized. Use writefile to save a run of values as a breakpoint text file that modmetro~ can read, or writebuf to write them into a buffer~.
The oscillator advances by freq / sr of a cycle per step, so one full cycle takes sr / freq steps. With the defaults (sr 10000, freq 100) a cycle lasts 100 beats.
Every setting is an attribute: type it into the object box (breakgen @wavetype 2 @freq 50), send it as a message (freq 50), or change it in the inspector, where it is saved with the patcher.

inlet.digest: (bang) Output the next tempo multiplier, (messages) attributes, set, writefile, writebuf
inlet.description: A bang outputs the next value. Attribute messages change the oscillator and randomization, and writefile and writebuf write a run of values to a file or buffer~.

outlet.digest: (float) Tempo multiplier for the next beat's length
outlet.description: The current oscillator value plus 1.0, after randomization. The periodic waveforms range from 0.0 to 2.0, so at full depth a beat can shrink to nothing or double in length. writefile can scale this range down (see depth); the outlet always sends the full range.

method.name: bang
method.description: Advances the oscillator one step, applies the current random mode, and sends the result out the outlet.

method.name: writefile
method.digest: Write a breakpoint file for modmetro~
method.description:
Opens a Save dialog, then writes steps values to the chosen text file, one per line with no trailing newline. This is the format modmetro~ reads. Each value advances the oscillator exactly as a bang would.
Each value's distance from 1.0 is scaled by a depth, written as (value − 1) × depth + 1. The depth comes from the depth attribute (default 1, the full range) unless you give one here. An explicit depth of 1 or more means full depth, and values below 1 are used as given, as in earlier versions. A depth of 0.2 keeps a sine between 0.8 and 1.2, i.e. beats up to 20% shorter or longer; full depth lets beats shrink to zero length at the bottom of a sine.

method.name: writebuf
method.description: Writes steps values into the buffer~ named by the buffer attribute, one per sample frame, stopping at the end of the buffer. Giving a buffer name first (writebuf mybuffer 1000) sets the buffer attribute and then writes. Each value advances the oscillator as a bang would, but 1.0 is subtracted so the values center on 0.0 (−1.0 to 1.0 for the periodic waveforms), the form modmetro~'s audiomod input expects. In a multichannel buffer every channel gets the same value. An error is reported if no buffer is set or the buffer doesn't exist.

method.name: set
method.digest: Set an attribute by name (older form)
method.description: set followed by an attribute name and value, e.g. set freq 100, is the same as sending the attribute message itself (freq 100). It is kept so patches written for earlier versions keep working. An unknown name, a missing value or an invalid value is reported in the Max Console and leaves the setting unchanged.

attribute.name: wavetype
attribute.description: 0 = sine (default), 1 = triangle, 2 = square, 3 = saw down, 4 = saw up, 5 = constant. Type 5 outputs the constval value on every step instead of an oscillator. Changing the waveform keeps the oscillator's current phase. Values outside 0–5 are reported as an error and ignored.

attribute.name: freq
attribute.description: Together with sr, sets how quickly the waveform cycles: one cycle takes sr / freq steps. Must be greater than 0. The default is 100.

attribute.name: sr
attribute.digest: Steps per second; setting it restarts the waveform
attribute.description: The number of steps per second of the oscillator, by analogy with an audio sample rate. One cycle takes sr / freq steps. Setting it also resets the oscillator's phase to the start of the cycle, which makes it the way to restart a waveform from the beginning. Must be greater than 0. The default is 10000.

attribute.name: constval
attribute.description: The value output on every step when wavetype is 5. Must be greater than 0 (earlier versions accepted any value through set constval). The default is 1.0.

attribute.name: random
attribute.description:
0 = no random (default): the waveform as it is.
1 = replace: every output is a new random value between 0.0 and 2.0, ignoring the waveform.
2 = multi: each output moves toward a new random value between 0.0 and 2.0 by the intensity fraction.
3 = multi interp: like multi, but the random target glides smoothly to a new random value every interval steps.

attribute.name: intensity
attribute.description: How far random modes 2 and 3 pull each output toward the random value: 0 = not at all, 1 = all the way. Negative values push away from it. The default is 0.05.

attribute.name: interval
attribute.digest: Steps between random targets in mode 3
attribute.description: The number of steps random mode 3 takes to glide to each new random target. Must be a whole number of at least 1. The default is 1.

attribute.name: buffer
attribute.description: The name of the buffer~ that writebuf writes into. There is no buffer by default. writebuf name steps also sets this attribute.

attribute.name: depth
attribute.description: How far the values written by writefile swing from 1.0, from 0 (every value is 1.0) to 1 (the full range, the default). A depth of 0.2 keeps beats within 20% of the tempo. A depth given with writefile overrides it. The outlet and writebuf are not affected.

entry.name: float
entry.description: A tempo multiplier, centered on 1.0, for each bang.
